title: Identify Outlier TPU Stack Trace
description: Enable stack traces on the workload (e.g., using --deploy-stacktrace-sidecar for XPK users) and query Cloud Logging for stack trace logs from the outlier TPU to determine if the hang is in the input pipeline.
instruction: python3 tools/scripts/pull_and_format_logs.py --project_id=${project_id} --workload_name=${workload_name} --filter_extra="(\"Traceback (most recent call last)\" OR \"step-stack-status\" OR \"stacktrace\") ${outlier_host}" --output_file=${output_file} --deduplicate=true --start=${start_time} --end=${end_time}

workload_name.description: Target TPU workload or JobSet name.

outlier_host.description: Optional outlier TPU pod or host name filter.

output_file.description: Output file path for extracted stack trace logs.
